note: User-prepared resin tinctures. These are not supplier products: identity anchors on the raw resin/botanical source, and the only unknown is the final dissolved-solids fraction, which stays fail-closed until assayed. Active fraction must never be defaulted.
stock_form: ethanol tincture (alcohol extract of the raw resin)

required_measurement.name: dry_residue_assay
required_measurement.method: Weigh a known aliquot (~1.000 g), evaporate at 60-80 C to constant mass, weigh the residue; dissolved-solids % w/w = residue / aliquot x 100.
required_measurement.effect: Replaces ASSAY_STATUS=HOLD with a measured active fraction; active_uL = raw_uL x measured_fraction.
